# garage_node (Data Source)

Build information of one node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_node" "self" {}

output "garage_version" {
  value = data.garage_node.self.garage_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Full node ID, or `self` (the default) for the node behind the endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `db_engine` (String) Metadata database engine.
- `garage_features` (List of String)
- `garage_version` (String)
- `node_id` (String)
- `rust_version` (String)
